sloka: ततो गत्वा दशग्रीवमासीनं परमासने ।ऊचुर्बद्धाञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वे एव निशाचराः ।। ६.६०.८६ ।।।।
transliteration: tato gatvā daśagrīvamāsīnaṁ paramāsane ।ūcurbaddhāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve eva niśācarāḥ ।। 6.60.86 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana on his part said this to the Rakshasas feeling cheerful. "Honour him as propriety demands. I wish to see him."
